sample_unit: MIMIC-IV ICU patients (930 annotated 30-min windows in RealICU-Gold; 11,862 windows in RealICU-Scale)
unlisted_practices: Hindsight-annotated benchmarks using senior physician review of the full patient trajectory rather than historical clinician actions as ground truth
Structured-memory agent (ICU-Evo) to improve long-horizon reasoning in ICU decision support

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an offline benchmark (RealICU) and a memory-agent architecture (ICU-Evo) for LLM decision support in ICU care without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
